      Settings

      Everything FogOfWar keeps: its settings and log, the engine, game and maps (several GB, in data) and the newest 50 replays (in replays). Changing it moves everything there.

      Use the patched engine build when one is published for a game's engine. Same replay, about a quarter faster, 1.5 GB less memory.

      The run stops before Windows has less than this much memory left, instead of freezing the computer.

      Before each run, the game builds, maps and engines used longest ago are deleted until the data folder fits. They download again if a game needs them.
